reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03's code reading is factually correct: assemble_data_column_sidecars at line 328 performs unchecked array access cell_proofs[i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + j] without validating that cell_proofs.len == blobs.len * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB. The 01e invariant (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json, lines 680-696, PROP-57888860-inv-027) explicitly requires: 'Each blob must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cell-proof pairs in cells_and_kzg_proofs construction.' The code violates this spec requirement. However, all three callers source data from semi-trusted boundaries: (1) nimbus_beacon_node.nim:2054 uses Engine API sendGetBlobsV2, (2) beacon_validators.nim:587 uses Engine API getPayload blobsBundle, (3) rest_beacon_api.nim:1108 uses Beacon API (out of scope per bug bounty rules). According to BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json trust_assumptions.engine_api, the Engine API is SEMI_TRUSTED (JWT-authenticated co-located EL-CL communication). Exploitation requires a compromised or buggy local EL to send malformed data (fewer proofs than required). Attacker control: none (semi-trusted source only). Path type: semi-trusted. This is a correctness bug in the Engine API data handling, not a security vulnerability exploitable by an external attacker. The prerequisite (compromised local EL) is outside the security model.
